newsitem.title: USA: PCX says launches interactive web site.
newsitem.headline: PCX says launches interactive web site.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange said it launched an interactive Internet site Monday on the World Wide Web.
The site, www.pacificex.com, offers information about the companies PCX lists as well as its other products and services in a specialized graphics format, the PCX said in a statement.

Other U.S. options exchanges also offer web sites, such as the Chicago Board Options Exchange at www.cboe.com, the American Stock Exchange at www.amex.com, and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange at www.phlx.com. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
